Vyper.why: Pure-gun carry whose spirit-amp splice is already gutted; Buff Containers' permanent Bullet Resist rolls tax her entire damage type for the match and Barrel Mimics punish the crate chains she has no disengage to escape. Still farms CC-light comps, still lifted out by hard-CC initiation (Dynamo, Mo & Krill).
Vyper.notes:
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; Bullet Resist container rolls tax her gun all game and Barrel Mimics punish crate chains she cannot disengage from.
09-16: Slither T3 barrier 5->4s / Petrifying Bola cd 105->115s are cosmetic; the real hit is indirect (Mercurial Magnum gut + Plated Armor on-hit fix), tier A->B, build pivots to pure gun.
54.6% WR / 26.9% PR is a pre-09-16 baseline (14-day snapshot, mostly pre-patch).

Mina.why: Mobile burst assassin with one of the patch's best farm shapes — grouped Haunt camps and new districts suit her AoE clear and dive routes — but her single-target rotation still cannot kill the tank front line (Billy, Mo & Krill, Victor), and that archetype just got better. Yamato still owns the mobile-burst niche.
Mina.notes:
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; grouped Haunt camps and new districts suit her AoE clear and dive routes, but the tank frontline she cannot kill got better.
09-29 City Never Sleeps: no direct change; camp/uptime patch rewards grouped-camp AoE clear and new-district mobility, but her damage gap is unchanged.
Last direct touch: 07-28-2026.

Drifter.why: Blind-pickable spirit-melee bruiser with a private income lane: heavy-melee Tough Crates, Steam Vents and the new hiding spots all extend his stealth-reveal roam. He still lacks hard CC and closing mobility, so Dynamo/Mo & Krill/Apollo lane pressure caps him at A.
Drifter.notes:
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; Steam Vents, new hiding spots and heavy-melee Tough Crates extend his stealth-roam and give his melee core uncontestable crate income.
09-29 City Never Sleeps: no direct change; new districts/Steam Vents and heavy-melee Tough-Crate routes fit his roam.
KB core_items cleaned of Decay/Toxic Bullets/Fortitude — none in current 30-day usage; the 'Toxic Bullets bot' framing is a 2026-04 artifact.

Venator.why: Gun-bruiser whose zoning just gained a popular hard counter — Graves' gun deletes his pre-placed traps — while permanent Bullet Resist rolls tax his gun and spread corridors add flank angles on a slow body. He still out-tanks fellow gun carries, but he is no longer a safe default.
Venator.last_changed_patch: Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit.
Venator.notes:
10-20 Shh...: Graves' gun destroys his traps — the pre-placed lane-vision/zoning habit now has a popular counter; tier A->B. Against a Graves, hold traps for fight setup instead of pre-placing them.
09-16: Ira Domini now works with Ricochet/Split Shot (3 bolts); Weakening Headshot -13->-12% nudges his lane shred relative to buffed Hollow Point.
Two-build reality: gun bruiser primary (70-90% shares), ~40% grenade pivot is the secondary late option.

Victor.why: Sustain frontline the camp meta feeds: harder Haunt camps, longer PvE routes and Buff Container resist rolls all reward his Spirit Lifesteal/Healing Booster stack — 56.4% WR is still the board's second-highest. Still the one tank burst and anti-heal can delete, and he drops the mirror to Abrams/Mo & Krill.
Victor.notes:
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; harder Haunt camps, longer PvE routes and Buff Container Bullet/Spirit Resist rolls feed his sustain stack — A held.
09-29 City Never Sleeps: no direct change; hard Haunt camps fed his sustain stack, flipping him from fair B-baseline to A on the 56.4% snapshot WR.
Data disagrees with the 07-16 creator read: Refresher/Echo Shard appear in none of his top-15 buys.

Paige.notes:
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; Healing Snacks let her lane pressure stick instead of resetting on a recall, and lane-adjacent crate routes from ~2:30 pay the lane winner immediately — S held.
City Never Sleeps: no direct change; lane-adjacent crate routes and Healing Snacks reward her lane pressure, and the contested hubs suit her carry-snowball.
09-16: heavy-melee spirit scaling 0.3->0.45, Captivating Read T1 -11->-14s / T3 +1m->+2m; Slowing Hex cd 27->29s a minor tax.

The Doorman.notes:
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; Bell Tower's single rope + ~280 souls keeps the Doorway kidnap real — pre-place the door at the base before roping up.
Paint the Town: no direct change; Bell Tower's single rope and ~280-soul payout give his Doorway a real kidnap objective play, but tempo dive still beats his setup.
09-16: no direct line; loses his Veil Walker disengage (Sprint Boots + movespeed-on-break removed).

Billy.notes:
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; harder Haunt camps reward sustained frontline presence, but Mo & Krill still owns the front-line slot and ranged corridor clear beats his all-in.
10-16 Paint the Town: no direct change; behavior-varied Haunt camps and contested soul sources reward sustained presence, so his lane-bully all-in fits the economy less.
10-05: no direct change; the trooper-speed fix marginally helps his lane-bully all-in, but his real slide (slot lost to Mo & Krill, anti-tank Shiv climbing) is unchanged.

Graves.why: Trap-clearing gun carry who finally has a job: her gun deletes Venator's pre-placed traps, making her a real counter-pick into a high-pick hero. The economy still denies her ~25-minute window — worst early game of any carry, no comeback bail-out — and Barrel Mimics punish her crate chains.
enabled_by: Venator in the lobby (gun deletes his traps)
Corrupted items at ~30 min (the only realistic late spike)
countered_by: mobile assassins (Holliday, Lash, Yamato, Mina, Calico, Drifter)
out-scaling gun carries (Haze, Silver, Wraith, Warden)
Barrel Mimics (crate chains while low HP)
Graves.last_changed_patch: Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit.
Graves.notes:
10-20 Shh...: tier C->B, trend rising — trap-clearing into Venator is a real draft lever, but Barrel Mimics punish her low-HP, two-stamina crate chains and the corridor economy still taxes her scaling window.
10-16 Paint the Town: her gun destroys Venator's traps - genuine utility into an A-tier hero - but the earlier, contested soul economy still deletes her ~25-min scaling line.
09-16: comeback souls trimmed and Rift resist made per-minute (comeback path gone); health/boon 33->35 + Jar of Dead buffs are small; Toxic Bullets scaling buff marginal.

Apollo.why: Tempo lane bully the rebuilt economy favors: he routes Haunt camps and turns lane wins into lane-adjacent crate routes and Healing Snacks, and his spirit core is untouched. The objective-parry change trims his T3-bullet-resist Guardian dive from a chain to a single commitment.
Apollo.notes:
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; lane pressure converts into lane-adjacent crate routes and Healing Snacks, but the objective-parry change makes the Guardian dive a one-shot decision — S held.
10-16 Paint the Town: no direct change; the objective-parry cooldown-reset removal trims the T3-bullet-resist Guardian-dive chain, but the crate-and-Haunt economy keeps him S.
10-14: Baba (beats him ~59%) took a major nerf — a marginal easing of a bad lane.
